categories.main_business_segments: Kajima Corporation operates five main business segments: Civil Engineering (infrastructure and public works), Building Construction (commercial, industrial, and residential buildings), Development (real estate development, design, and engineering), Domestic Group Companies (specialized construction, leasing, and property management in Japan), and Overseas Group Companies (construction and development in North America, Europe, Asia, and Oceania).
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: Kajima leverages advanced construction technologies such as automated and digitalized construction methods, proprietary structural engineering (e.g., 'Kajima Straight Beam Method'), robotics for welding and tunnel excavation, high-flow and low-cost concrete, and environmental technologies like CO2-absorbing concrete. The company also invests in R&D for automation, digital transformation (DX), and sustainable construction materials.
categories.primary_customers_markets: The company serves a diverse customer base including government agencies, private corporations, real estate developers, manufacturers, logistics companies, and public infrastructure operators. Major end markets include public infrastructure, commercial and industrial facilities, logistics centers, residential complexes, and overseas development projects.
categories.geographic_coverage: Kajima operates primarily in Japan but has significant business activities in North America (especially the US), Europe (UK, Germany, Poland, France, Czech Republic), Asia (Singapore, Indonesia, Malaysia, Vietnam, India, Myanmar, Philippines, Taiwan, China), and Oceania (Australia). The company has a global network of subsidiaries and affiliates.
categories.supply_chain_position: Kajima is positioned as a downstream player, acting as a general contractor and developer, directly delivering construction, engineering, and real estate development services to end clients. It also manages and coordinates upstream suppliers and subcontractors within its projects.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: Strategic priorities include strengthening core domestic construction and real estate development, expanding overseas business, and driving innovation through R&D in automation, digitalization, and sustainability. The company emphasizes solutions for labor shortages, productivity improvement, decarbonization, circular economy, and open innovation with external partners. R&D investment is focused on construction automation, digital transformation, and environmental technologies.
categories.revenue_model: Kajima generates revenue primarily through construction contracts (project-based sales), real estate development and sales, property leasing, engineering services, and facility management. Additional income streams include leasing, specialized construction services, and property management through group companies.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: Kajima is one of Japan's leading general contractors (super general contractors), competing with firms such as Obayashi, Shimizu, Taisei, and Takenaka. It holds a strong market position domestically and is recognized for its technological capabilities and global reach, with a growing presence in overseas markets.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: For the fiscal year ending March 2025, Kajima reported consolidated net sales of approximately 2.91 trillion yen and net income attributable to shareholders of 125.8 billion yen, with over 21,000 employees. The company has achieved consecutive years of revenue and profit growth, with a robust balance sheet and a target to further increase profits and maintain ROE above 10%.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: Kajima differentiates itself through advanced engineering and construction technologies, integrated project delivery (from design to construction and development), strong project management, and a commitment to sustainability and innovation. The company emphasizes high quality, safety, environmental responsibility, and the ability to deliver large-scale, complex projects both domestically and internationally.
